# Blast Bridge

> Blast Bridge is a non-custodial interface for bridging ETH and stablecoins between Ethereum and Blast, an optimistic rollup layer 2 on Ethereum. Users connect their own wallet and sign every transaction. The page explains native versus fast bridges, fees and gas, and bridge risks.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- Blast is an optimistic rollup layer 2 that settles on Ethereum.
- Gas on Blast is paid in ETH.
- Native withdrawals from Blast to Ethereum use the rollup challenge period of about 7 days.
- Blast has native yield-bearing ETH and USDB; yield rules are set by Blast and are not guaranteed.
- The interface is non-custodial: it never holds funds or keys, and the user signs from their own wallet.

## Pages

- Blast Bridge & learn: https://bridge-blast.github.io/
- Legal: https://bridge-blast.github.io/legal.html
